examples.title: Ассортиментные группы и число моделей
sql: SELECT g.GroupID, g.GroupName, g.Season, COUNT(p.ProductID) AS Models
FROM ProductGroups g
LEFT JOIN Products p ON p.GroupID = g.GroupID
GROUP BY g.GroupID, g.GroupName, g.Season
ORDER BY g.GroupID;

examples.title: Выпуск за последний рабочий день
sql: SELECT l.ProducedAt, w.WorkshopName, e.FullName, p.Article, l.QtyMade, l.QtyDefect
FROM ProductionLog l
JOIN Workshops w ON w.WorkshopID = l.WorkshopID
JOIN Employees e ON e.EmployeeID = l.EmployeeID
JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = l.ProductID
WHERE l.ProducedAt >= '20261030' AND l.ProducedAt < '20261031'
ORDER BY l.ProducedAt;

examples.title: Заказ и его строки
sql: SELECT o.OrderID, c.CustomerName, o.OrderDate, o.DueDate, o.ShipDate, o.Status,
p.Article, p.ProductName, ol.Qty, ol.Price
FROM Orders o
JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
JOIN OrderLines ol ON ol.OrderID = o.OrderID
JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = ol.ProductID
WHERE o.OrderID = 25100;

examples.title: Выпуск и брак по группам
sql: SELECT g.GroupName, SUM(l.QtyMade) AS Made, SUM(l.QtyDefect) AS Defect,
CAST(SUM(l.QtyDefect) * 100.0 / SUM(l.QtyMade) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS DefectPct, g.PlanDefectPct
FROM ProductionLog l
JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = l.ProductID
JOIN ProductGroups g ON g.GroupID = p.GroupID
GROUP BY g.GroupName, g.PlanDefectPct
ORDER BY DefectPct DESC;

examples.title: Отгрузки по месяцам
sql: SELECT FORMAT(o.ShipDate, 'yyyy-MM') AS Mon, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) AS Orders, SUM(ol.Qty) AS Qty,
CAST(SUM(ol.Qty * ol.Price * (1 - o.DiscountPct / 100)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS Revenue
FROM Orders o
JOIN OrderLines ol ON ol.OrderID = o.OrderID
WHERE o.Status = N'Отгружен'
GROUP BY FORMAT(o.ShipDate, 'yyyy-MM')
ORDER BY Mon;

examples.title: Кто кому подчиняется
sql: SELECT e.FullName AS Employee, e.Position, m.FullName AS Manager, m.Position AS ManagerPosition
FROM Employees e
LEFT JOIN Employees m ON m.EmployeeID = e.ManagerID
ORDER BY m.FullName, e.FullName;

examples.title: Просроченные заказы на сегодня
sql: -- «Сегодня» в этой базе — 31.10.2026
SELECT o.OrderID, c.CustomerName, o.DueDate, DATEDIFF(day, o.DueDate, GETDATE()) AS OverdueDays
FROM Orders o
JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
WHERE o.ShipDate IS NULL AND o.Status IN (N'Новый', N'В работе') AND o.DueDate < CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
ORDER BY OverdueDays DESC;

examples.title: Две базы: сотрудники — клиенты банка
sql: -- Таблица другой базы: ИмяБазы.dbo.Таблица
SELECT e.FullName, e.Position, e.Phone, b.ClientID AS BankClientID
FROM Sewing.dbo.Employees e
JOIN Bank.dbo.Clients b ON b.Phone = e.Phone
ORDER BY e.FullName;

examples.title: USE: переключение базы
sql: USE Bank;
SELECT DB_NAME() AS CurrentDb, COUNT(*) AS Clients FROM Clients;
examples.note: После выполнения песочница переключится на базу Bank — как в SSMS.
